title: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity's /teamwork
one_liner: Google Research 公布 Antigravity /teamwork 多智能体系统成果：配合 Gemini 4 系列模型，在数学化学系统软件与 ML 工程的开放问题上与人类专家协作...
summary_zh: Google Research 公布 Antigravity /teamwork 多智能体系统成果：配合 Gemini 4 系列模型，在数学化学系统软件与 ML 工程的开放问题上与人类专家协作，报告信息论形式化验证分子结构发现与 kernel 优化方面的进展设计针对两个模型局限：单次生成不可预测，以并行探索配专属证伪器（Lean 4 证明检查器原样测试套件执行模拟器等）；多天任务注意力发散，以按构造分区上下文让每个专项 agent 保持有界范围
summary_en: Google Research shares results from Antigravity's /teamwork multiagent systems, built on Gemini 4 models (Argon, Carbon, Hydrogen), for human-AI collaboration on open problems in mathematics, chemistry, systems software, and ML engineering, reporting advances in information theory, formal verification, molecular structure discovery, and kernel optimization. Two model limits motivate the design: unpredictable single-attempt generation, bridged by pairing parallel exploration with dedicated falsifiers (Lean 4 proof checker, unmodified test suites, execution simulators, web search, hardware counters), and attention dispersal over multi-day tasks, addressed by partitioning context by construction so each specialized agent keeps a bounded scope. The tools are being made available externally to researchers and developers.
